name: a message that resolves an earlier commitment
why: Post-processing step 4. The earlier commitment is set superseded with superseded_by pointing at the new row. Never deleted (docs/03 Retention). Note this case must bypass the step-5 dedup: a resolving message is BY DEFINITION about the same thing as the commitment it resolves, so a dedup pass that ran first would drop it and the old row would stay open forever.
